subject: Staged release plan for eval assets & governance checklist
thread_body:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: sara@brighretail.com, tom.reynolds@brighretail.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged release plan for eval assets & governance checklist

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call this week. As discussed, attached is a proposed staged release playbook for the evaluation assets (prompt pack + curated testcases). High-level goals: unblock BrightRetail's model evaluation while keeping your IP and sample data protected, and give us measurable acceptance milestones so we can move toward a pilot.

Key points in this deliverable:
- Staged asset releases: seed prompt pack (subset) -> full prompt pack -> full testcase corpus.
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only, no redistribution, no synthetic generation for benchmarking outside the scope, 90-day retention window in the sandbox.
- Acceptance criteria per stage (sample pass rates, latency envelopes, qualitative checks).
- Who does what: mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and handoff triggers.
- Logistics: access to sandbox, temporary credentials, and audit log collection.

Attachments: brightretail-promptpack-v1.zip (subset), brightretail-testcases-sample.csv, MAP-staged-timeline-v1.pdf

Request: Can you confirm that the 90-day retention + evaluation-only clause aligns with BrightRetail's legal/compliance needs? If so, we'll lock the MAP and provide sandbox creds by next Wednesday (Nov 4).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0147

---

From: Sara Park <sara@brighretail.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reynolds@brighretail.com
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2026 11:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged release plan for eval assets & governance checklist

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the clear plan and the artifacts. A few quick items from our side:

1) Legal needs to review the wording around "no synthetic generation for benchmarking outside the scope" — they usually ask for concrete examples and a clause allowing limited internal model testing.
2) Can we shorten the retention window to 60 days for the initial stage? We can make it 90 after legal signs off.
3) For acceptance, can you add a qualitative user-satisfaction checkpoint (our product team will validate generated copy for intent/brand tone)?

If you can incorporate those, we'll route to procurement and legal. Also cc'd Tom to align on internal reviewers.

Best,
Sara Park
Head of ML Ops, BrightRetail
sara@brighretail.com

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, sara@brighretail.com, tom.reynolds@brighretail.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2026 13:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged release plan for eval assets & governance checklist

Thanks Lauren — looping in a few legal/controls considerations we typically apply for staged MAPs: 

- Definitive scope: we should enumerate exactly which prompt templates / columns in the testcase CSV are allowed for evaluation and which are redacted.
- Derivative generation: propose a narrow clause that permits internal model tuning/evaluation but prohibits distribution or external benchmarking; suggested language: "Permitted: internal model evaluation for product compatibility; Prohibited: re-publishing prompt/testcase material or generating derivative datasets for resale."
- Retention: BrightRetail's ask for 60 days is reasonable for the seed stage; we'll document staged retention windows in the MAP PDF (seed: 60 days; full pack: 90 days).
- Audit: we will enable token-level audit logs for your account and share a weekly summary during the evaluation window.

Action items for legal/procurement:
1) BrightRetail legal to confirm acceptance of the derivative generation clause.
2) Redwood legal to prepare a short Rider to the standard NDA that captures these retention & usage constraints (we'll aim for a 2-business-day turnaround once we get confirmation).

I'll draft the Rider and a single-sheet MAP checklist and post to the shared Drive. Monica — can you confirm sandbox credential TTL and audit exports?

-Markus
Sr. Legal Counsel (contracting lead), Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: monica.patel@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged release plan for eval assets & governance checklist

Hi all —

Sandbox / ops notes:
- We'll provision a dedicated BrightRetail sandbox (us-west-2) with a 2‑node GPU pool for the eval period.
- Temp creds will be issued via our portal; TTL = 14 days per credential. We can set an automated rotation schedule.
- Audit exports: token-level logs will be delivered to your S3 bucket (you can give us a short-term bucket or we can push to a secured Redwood bucket with read-only creds for Tom).
- Data handling: uploaded prompt/testcase files will be stored encrypted-at-rest; we'll enforce the Stage 1 access controls and delete the files per retention windows in the MAP.

Next steps I need from BrightRetail:
1) Confirm S3 bucket or allow Redwood-managed bucket (we'll share minimal read-only creds).
2) Confirm internal reviewer for the qualitative check (name + contact) so we can add to acceptance criteria.

I'll attach the sandbox onboarding checklist to the Drive folder once creds are ready.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
